product_one_liner.value: Rasayel is a WhatsApp communication and automation platform for B2B sales and customer-facing teams, combining a shared inbox, chatbots, follow-ups and CRM integrations.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 15 employees; its broader company-size label is 11–50.

hq_location.notes: Reported headquarters; the company operates remotely.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog is a WhatsApp sales/marketing learning center; no qualifying pair of engineering-authored product implementation posts was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page states there are no open jobs.

model_provider.notes: No model/provider disclosure found in the public AI documentation, privacy policy, security policy or available subprocessor material.

compliance_certs.notes: No Rasayel certification among the five requested was claimed on these pages. The privacy policy discusses GDPR legal bases and rights, not certification; its PCI Level 1 statement concerns Stripe, not Rasayel.

last_funding.notes: Amount undisclosed. The conflicting October 2026 $10 million Series A reports could not be reliably attributed to this WhatsApp company: related coverage describes an AI-logistics business.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest attributable round is dated February 2022, before the 2025-05-09 cutoff; same-name AI-logistics funding coverage was excluded.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page states there are no open jobs.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated feature release in the changelog is automated HubSpot property updates on 2026-04-28, before the 2026-05-09 cutoff.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small published team lists only the longstanding CEO and COO co-founders as C-level leaders, and no VPs; no qualifying departure announcement was found. The COO profile dates that role to March 2024.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive and Zapier are advertised integrations, not proof of internal deployment. Sales Navigator, Crunchbase and OpenPhone are explicitly offered to the sales hire in a now-closed posting.
